question: On each harness (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Hermes Agent, Pi), as the installed catalog grows from 100 to 351, 700 and 1,500 skills, does the model see, open and use the right skill more often with gbrain's resolver installed by gbrain setup than with the harness alone, and from what catalog size? inputs.note: Staged on every run machine before plan, outside git (.skills-at-scale/ is ignored). plan records the set file's sha256 in manifest.json request_sets and run refuses a set that changed (HE-PREREG-004); run preflight refuses an image whose harness-eval.sas-catalog label is not the cell catalog's catalog_hash (HE-ADAPTER-005).
